# Supplier Service-Level and Resilience Governance

## Purpose

Align supplier reliability commitments and recovery expectations with actual business impact.

## Expectations

Material supplier arrangements SHOULD consider availability, support responsiveness, recovery commitments, maintenance/change notification, data portability, incident communication, capacity or quota constraints, and termination support.

## Evidence

Contractual targets are not evidence of actual resilience. Monitor material performance and recovery behavior where dependency risk warrants it.

## Gaps

When supplier capability is below internal recovery need, treatment may require redundancy, alternate process, reduced dependency, stronger contract terms, or accepted residual risk.
